name: insync-mcp
description: Read an InSync Healthcare (Qualifacts) patient portal — appointments, medications, allergies, messages, forms and balance — by signing in server-side with your portal password, or by relaying through your signed-in browser tab.

tools.name: insync_get_counts
tools.description: Dashboard badge counts: unread messages, medications, allergies, problems, lab results, immunizations, and pending forms and surveys.

tools.name: insync_get_balance
tools.description: Patient account balance: the amount owed (net due) and any credit balance.

tools.name: insync_list_appointments
tools.description: Upcoming or past appointments/visits with date, time, provider, facility, visit type, status and expected copay.

tools.name: insync_get_appointment_calendar
tools.description: Monthly appointment calendar: day, time slot and label of each scheduled visit in a date range (defaults to the current month).

tools.name: insync_list_medications
tools.description: Prescriptions/medications on file (current, discontinued or cancelled): drug, dispense, quantity, refills, days supply, date and prescriber.

tools.name: insync_list_allergies
tools.description: The patient's recorded allergies and their reactions.

tools.name: insync_list_messages
tools.description: Secure messages from the practice (unread, read or sent). Listing does not mark anything read. Returns the ids insync_get_message needs.

tools.name: insync_get_message
tools.description: Read one secure message in full. NOT read-only: opening an UNREAD message marks it read unless allow_mark_read is confirmed; an already-read message opens freely.

tools.name: insync_list_forms
tools.description: Patient intake/consent forms the practice sent (pending or all). Embedded form markup and login credentials are never returned.

tools.name: insync_list_surveys
tools.description: Patient surveys the practice sent, with each survey's name and received date.

tools.name: insync_list_documents
tools.description: Documents filed to the patient's portal account.

tools.name: insync_get_profile
tools.description: The patient's demographic profile (scalar fields only). The photo, picklists and any credential-shaped field are never returned.

tools.name: insync_list_refill_requests
tools.description: The patient's prescription refill-request history (grid rows with status and dates). Does not submit a refill.

tools.name: insync_list_attachments
tools.description: List the files attached to a secure message by its master id. Returns each attachment's name and position; use insync_download_attachment to retrieve one. Listing does not open or mark the message read.

tools.name: insync_download_attachment
tools.description: Download one file attached to a secure message, by the message's master id and the attachment's position from insync_list_attachments. Saves to disk locally or returns bytes inline when hosted; goes through the portal, never direct storage.

tools.name: insync_download_document
tools.description: Download a document filed to the patient's portal account, by the folder_url and file_name from insync_list_documents. Saves to disk locally or returns bytes inline when hosted; goes through the portal, never direct storage.

tools.name: insync_upload_insurance_card
tools.description: Upload a photo of your insurance card (front, back, or both) to your own InSync profile, from a local JPG/JPEG/PNG file. Writes to the portal and is irreversible, so it is confirm-gated: the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token uploads.

tools.name: insync_healthcheck
tools.description: Report portal connectivity from whichever transport is live: the server-side credential sign-in, or the browser bridge. Skipped when no credential resolves.

insync_portal.title: Portal URL
insync_portal.description: Your practice's portal, scheme and host only, e.g. https://<practice>intouch.insynchcs.com.

insync_username.title: Portal username
insync_username.description: Portal username. Set with the password to sign in server-side. Leave both empty to relay through your signed-in browser tab.

insync_password.title: Portal password
insync_password.description: Portal password. A rejected sign-in is never retried automatically, because the portal counts failures toward a lockout.

insync_transport.title: Transport (advanced)
insync_transport.description: server or fetchproxy. Default: server when username and password are both set, otherwise fetchproxy.

insync_ws_port.title: fetchproxy port (advanced)
insync_ws_port.description: fetchproxy concentrator port (fetchproxy transport only, default 37149). The whole fleet shares this one port; override only when hosting.

insync_output_dir.title: Download directory (advanced)
insync_output_dir.description: Where downloaded files are written (a path-delimiter list; ~ expands). Default ~/Downloads and ~/Documents. A per-call dest must resolve inside one of these.

insync_inline_downloads.title: Inline downloads (advanced)
insync_inline_downloads.description: true returns downloaded bytes inline (base64) instead of writing to disk, for a hosted runner whose disk you cannot reach. Default false.

fetchproxy_ws_host.title: fetchproxy bind address (advanced)
fetchproxy_ws_host.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator, a literal IP only (default 127.0.0.1). Keep on loopback; it exists for hosted deployments that run each MCP in its own network namespace.

fetchproxy_identity_dir.title: fetchproxy identity directory (advanced)
fetchproxy_identity_dir.description: Absolute path where the fetchproxy long-term identity keypair is stored (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/).
